speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. Please describe exactly where your knee pain is located and how it started after your recent increase in physical activity. To better understand the severity, have you noticed any swelling, redness, or a "popping" sound at the time of injury?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old female. The patient presents with knee pain that started yesterday and has been steadily worsening. She cites recent participation in volleyball involving repetitive pivoting and twisting movements as a possible cause. She was advised at her last physical exam that weight loss could be beneficial for her health.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) Tear.

Based on your age, the mechanism of injury involving repetitive pivoting during volleyball, and the sudden onset of worsening pain, this is highly suggestive of an ACL tear. I recommend we proceed with imaging to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST IMAGES: Knee_MRI. REQUEST TEST: MRI_Knee.
